import html # Define a simple HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ Response

User Response

{user_content}
""" def generate_html_response(user_content: str) -> str: """ Generates an HTML page by safely embedding the provided user content. Parameters ---------- user_content : str The raw content supplied by the user that should appear in the page. Returns ------- str A complete HTML document with the user content safely escaped. """ # Escape special HTML characters to prevent injection attacks (CWE-74). safe_content = html.escape(user_content, quote=True) return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
